summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 13 backend tests (5 new tscheck files + pre-existing test_engine_unit.py) and 6 named browser checks. Everything passed.

checks.criterion: Full demo flight lifecycle LFPG→LSGG by a pilot
checks.name: demo-flight-lifecycle
checks.evidence: Pilot created demo flight (sim factor 120), clicked all phase actions prêt→repoussage→roulage→point d'attente→décollage→(auto en route)→approche→atterrissage→roulage arrivée→parking→terminer; FICTIF badge visible; Historique tab showed 8+ event-item rows including actor 'Pilote'.

checks.criterion: Server-side progression, shared between pilot and ATC
checks.name: shared-progression-pilot-atc
checks.evidence: Second browser context logged in as ATC opened the same flight and detail-phase data-phase matched the pilot's (en_route); after an 8s unattended wait + reload, detail-next-wp/detail-alt values changed, proving server-side ticker progression without the pilot's tab open.

checks.name: test_tscheck_role_enforcement.py
checks.evidence: POST /flights/demo as atc -> 403; POST /flights/{id}/control as pilote -> 403; second pilote account acting on another pilot's flight -> 403; anonymous GET /flights -> 401; GET /admin/users as pilote/atc -> 403, as admin -> 200. 5 tests passed.

checks.criterion: Invalid state transitions and stale versions rejected
checks.name: test_tscheck_invalid_transitions.py
checks.evidence: POST /flights/{id}/actions action=decollage from phase=preparation -> 409 detail 'Transition refusée : « Décollage » impossible depuis l'état « Préparation ».'; reusing a stale version after a successful transition -> 409. 2 tests passed.

checks.name: atc-controls-tab
checks.evidence: On the Contrôle tab, ATC clicked pause (hold indicator flips to 'Reprendre'), resume, selected a waypoint and applied it, picked free-position mode and clicked the map (position-kind became 'POSITION MANUELLE (ATC)'); Historique tab text included both 'pause' and 'position' entries.

checks.name: test_tscheck_atc_controls.py
checks.evidence: POST /flights/{id}/control op=pause -> hold=true, op=resume -> hold=false, op=set_waypoint, op=set_position(free) -> position.lat/lon match sent coords; events included pause/position entries; pilot calling /control -> 403. 2 tests passed.

checks.name: taxi-route-editing
checks.evidence: Pilot clicked connected LFPG nodes STAND DEMO 1→TWY A1→TWY A2 on the map, saved -> status PROPOSÉ; a disconnected LSGG pair (STAND DEMO 11, STAND DEMO 12) showed 'non relié' and disabled Save; second browser context as ATC validated the proposed route -> status VALIDÉ.

checks.name: test_tscheck_taxi_route.py
checks.evidence: PUT /flights/{id}/taxi with connected node_ids [S1,A1,A2] -> 200, status propose; POST /taxi/validate -> status valide; disconnected [S1,H2] -> 400 'ne sont pas reliés par un segment'. 1 test passed.

checks.name: simbrief-import-error
checks.evidence: Nouveau vol > Import SimBrief, Pilot ID '0' -> French error 'Identifiant SimBrief inconnu. Vérifiez votre Pilot ID ou nom d'utilisateur.' shown; no preview/flight created.

checks.name: persistence-and-admin
checks.evidence: Pilot flight phase persisted across a page reload; admin changed a freshly-registered fixture user's role to atc via /admin; admin forced a flight's phase to 'roulage' with a reason, visible both on the flight (detail-phase data-phase=roulage) and in the global Journal tab containing the reason text.

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_persistence.py
checks.evidence: PATCH /admin/users/{id} role=atc -> 200 and reflected in GET /admin/users; POST /flights/{id}/force with reason -> 200, phase persists on re-GET, reason appears in both /flights/{id}/events and /admin/events; non-admin force -> 403. 3 tests passed.
